meta.name: form-codegen
meta.description: Model authoring and form generation across tinywasm/model, tinywasm/orm (ormc), tinywasm/form, tinywasm/json, and tinywasm/dom. Use when creating or modifying models/DTOs, input widgets, ormc code generation, field validation, widget assignment, or form API design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 基于模型定义自动生成表单与代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 tinywasm 生态中快速生成模型和表单代码
copy.tagline_en: Generate forms and code from model definitions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate models and form code in the tinywasm ecosystem

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 model.Definition 定义数据模型，并自动生成 Go 结构体、验证、编解码等代码。你只需写模型定义，Claude 会确保字段类型、数据库映射、表单控件等正确，并运行 ormc 生成代码。
howto.when: 当你需要创建或修改数据模型、DTO、表单输入控件、数据库映射，或生成 ormc 代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个登录数据模型，包含 email 和 password 字段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you define data models using typed model.Definition literals and automatically generates Go structs, validation, codecs, etc. You only write the model definition; Claude ensures correct field types, DB mappings, form widgets, and runs ormc to generate code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create or modify data models, DTOs, input widgets, DB mappings, or generate ormc code.

say_en.text: Create a login data model with email and password fields.
say_en.note: Claude will generate LoginDataModel and prompt to run go generate.

say_en.text: Add a price field to the Product model, type float, with number input widget.
say_en.note: Claude will modify ProductModel and suggest regenerating code.
